messages.subject: How to melt and facet my data properly.
parts:
Folks,

Here is my data.frame:

structure(list(Order = 1:7, Rating = c("AAA", "AA", "A", "A-",
"BBB", "BBB-", NA), CDR0 = c(94.75, 92.61, 97.89, 85.97, 101.15,
91.62, 99.46), CDR4 = c(95, 92.74, 98, 85.91, 101.13, 91.56,
99.59), CDR8 = c(95.34, 93.13, 98.07, 86.12, 101.13, 91.63, 99.92
), CDR16 = c(93.87, 92, 91.34, 85.44, 47.93, 92.02, 90.47), CDR32 = c(90.43,
72.16, 68.54, 14.64, 40.21, 59.6, 58.29), CDR50 = c(84.29, 58.07,
61.64, 0.66, 29.09, 49.28, 45.71), Actual = c(95.23, 89.92, 97.42,
85.9, 101.61, 91.43, 98.77)), .Names = c("Order", "Rating", "CDR0",
"CDR4", "CDR8", "CDR16", "CDR32", "CDR50", "Actual"), row.names = c(NA,
-7L), class = "data.frame")

Here is a badly tabbed print of the data frame.

Order Rating CDR0 CDR4 CDR8 CDR16 CDR32 CDR50 Actual
1 1 AAA 94.75 95.00 95.34 93.87 90.43 84.29 95.23
2 2 AA 92.61 92.74 93.13 92.00 72.16 58.07 89.92
3 3 A 97.89 98.00 98.07 91.34 68.54 61.64 97.42
4 4 A- 85.97 85.91 86.12 85.44 14.64 0.66 85.90
5 5 BBB 101.15 101.13 101.13 47.93 40.21 29.09 101.61
6 6 BBB- 91.62 91.56 91.63 92.02 59.60 49.28 91.43
7 7 <NA> 99.46 99.59 99.92 90.47 58.29 45.71 98.77

For a small handout I would like to create a faceted graph where each row of the data.frame is a line graph from column CDR0 through CDR50.

Unfortunately I am getting stuck on both melting this data correctly and then creating the graphs.

Any pointers or links would be very much appreciated.


Thanks for your time,
Best,
KW



---
KW

parts:
Something like this?


#get the data from below, then remove unnecessary columns
d <- d[,-c(1,9)]

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
d <- melt(d)
head(d)
ggplot(d, aes(x=as.factor(variable), y=value)) +
geom_line(aes(group=1)) + facet_grid(~Rating) +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, vjust=1, size=12))

messages.author: 5a37f1244321fb07
messages.subject: RE: How to melt and facet my data properly.
parts:
You can control the order by changing 'Rating' variable to an ordered factor, such as:

mylabel <- c("AAA", "AA", "A", "A-", "BBB", "BBB-", "NA") #----the order you want

d$Rating <- ordered(d$Rating, labels=mylabel, levels=mylabel) #--change Rating to ordered factor

Kaori
